description: This file defines an ExceptionHandler class that implements the Thread.UncaughtExceptionHandler interface for handling uncaught exceptions in an Android application. It logs the exception, starts an activity to display the exception details, finishes the current activity, and terminates the runtime.

classes.name: ExceptionHandler
classes.description: A custom exception handler for uncaught exceptions in an Android app, which logs the exception and initiates a user-facing activity before terminating the app.

methods.name: ExceptionHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with an Activity context.

methods.name: uncaughtException
methods.description: Handles uncaught exceptions by logging, starting an exception display activity, finishing the current activity, and exiting the runtime.
